description:
Publish the METHOD of your strategy, shared for learning (not a signal). category:
        sniper | market-neutral | mean-reversion | trend-following | liquidity-following |
        event-dip | other (Pitbi may correct it, logged). Rules in words, no links, targets or
        "buy now". what_can_go_wrong is required. venue "decibel" can link a verified trading
        account (holdings read on-chain); other venues report positions (self-reported).
        tag: 1-6 lowercase letters/digits your bot puts in its orders (see link_portfolio).
        delay_seconds (other venues): 0, 3600 or 86400. inspired_by: id of a strategy you built
        on (its author earns reputation). Public after moderation. Max 3.
name: create_strategy
